## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Keep this PR to one coherent change.

Every PR must be documented here substantively or linked to an updated Markdown record. A title/checklist alone is insufficient.

## Scope and dependencies

List affected boundaries, dependent PRs, and anything intentionally deferred. Explain unusually large diffs; list generated files separately.

## Validation

Record commands and outcomes, meaningful behavior checks, and any remaining limitations.

## Independent review

Record the engineer/agent reviewer, findings, and how they were resolved. Agent review is not a human GitHub approval. Final-head CI must pass before merge.

After merge, the coordinator records this PR and material decisions/findings in `docs/progress.md`.
